translation: Mikuru and Kyon, and also your little sister!

They say kids are good at sensing the
supernatural, so I definitely want her here!
Yeah, I'll do my best!

Don't try too hard, little sister. Right now I'm
desperate for a cover-up.
Umm, where should we start the investigation?

Hmm, good question… Kyon, where do you think
is best? Follow your intuition!

If you're searching for something spiritual,
how about the old building?

…I say, trying to steer Haruhi away from the
building where the 1st-year classrooms are.

That's stupid. Yuki and Koizumi are already
over there gathering information.

But I'm calling it now, the first-year rooms in
the main building are totally suspicious!

Then don't ask my opinion—I'm pretty sure
god would sympathize if I complained about it.
So, on that note, let's go.

Unnatural phenomena will be in plain sight, I'm
sure of it!
Eeeeh, in plain sight?

Look what you did. Asahina is completely
frightened.
Unnaaatural phenomenaaa, come out heeere!
Ahaha! Keep it up, little sister!
…Give me a break. No, seriously.

The main building is huge. It'll be hard to check
out the whole place, won't it?

Little sister, where do you think would be
suspicious?

Hey, stop treating my little sister as your
unnatural phenomena radar.
It's fine isn't it?
Hmmm, what about this room?

Class 1-6, huh. Six is a nice number—it has
that devil number feel.

Don't get overly obsessed with those
delusions—they'll probably become reality.
It l-looks kinda dark and scary.

Obviously—the lights aren't on. Let's hurry
in. Come on, quickly.
EEEEeeeeh?!
I-it's darkk… Suzumiyaaa!

The atmosphere is on point. It's a perfect fit
for the birthplace of unnatural phenomena.
Huh? Something's moving?
[#SK0Eek]?! Wh-what is it?!

When I looked closer, something was gently
swaying in the faint darkness…
Where?!
Look, over there. By the window!
By the window…?
Oh, what? It's just the curtain swaying.
C-curtain? Is that really it?

Asahina didn't even make any effort to look
at the window, perhaps out of fear.

She seems to have a hard time with this occult
stuff.

Yeah, it's true. Seems like the air through the
slightly open window is causing them to sway.
The window… is open?

It's the work of a yokai! I'm sure of it! It's
got to be one of those window-opening yokai!

I've never heard of a window-opening yokai.
Don't just say whatever pops in your mind.

Um, I'm not very good with that kind of stuff…
It's scary.

I understand, but please don't worry—it's
really just the curtain.
Thank goodness…
Being bad with the occult is very Asahina.

It is without a doubt just the curtains but…
there's still something strange about it.
Wh-what's strange?!

The window is slightly open. That allowed wind
to blow in and shake the curtains…

It's strange that the window for a class no
one uses is open during summer break.
So it is the work of a ghost, after all!
[#SK0Eeeeeeeeehhhhhhh]?!

I know she's not being serious, but Asahina
was frightened for real.
Let's reflect on what you've done…

Anyways, someone must've just forgotten to
close the window before going home.

Although it's summer vacation, there are still
various club activities and summer classes.
Ah… of course. That's right.

Give me a break. It just being the curtain is
way too disappointing to be fair.

I had high hopes for it to be a hanged ghost
or something.

How could you even imagine something so
nasty?

There's nothing strange about it. People talk
about that kind of thing all the time.

The stress of having gotten bad grades
leading to hanging yourself in the classroom…

They're left with a grudge and unable to rest
in peace, so they haunt the school!
[#SE003][#SK0Suzumiya], please stop it!

Haruhi, that's enough. You're scaring
Asahina.

It's rumored that nobody who sees their
figure returns alive.

Then how is the rumor spreading? All the
eyewitnesses should be dead.

…That's what makes it unnatural phenomena,
surely.
Once again, saying whatever comes to mind.

This is no good, there's nothing here but
darkness.
Let's look somewhere else.
Th-there are other places we're going…?

It's only natural. Now then, little sister, tell us
where we're going next.
Hmm… Let's see…
Just say you want to go home.
But I'm doing just fine?

It's a pity you can't pick up on your brother's
true intentions, little sister.
Ah, right. How about the library?

The library, huh… I see. Not a bad idea at all,
it's right downstairs.
Alright then, the library it is!

You say that… but being the middle of summer
vacation, it's bound to be locked.

The staff room is on the same floor isn't it?
We can just borrow the key from there.

…Good grief, I wish you'd put that vitality of
yours towards something else.

Maybe on helping me with my summer homework
or something—there's all sorts of options.

We borrowed the key to the library exactly as
Haruhi said, but…
Hey, Haruhi.
What is it?

Be honest with me… How did you get the library
key?

I just told them I was going to borrow it, and
did.
From who?
Beats me. No one was there.

That's not what the general public would call
getting permission.
T-this place is also dark.

Should we turn on the lights? Where's the
switch~?

Oh, it's hard to find the switch in here. Where
was it again?
Kyon…
Everything's okay, I'm right here beside you.
Even so, this darkness is seriously unsettling.

So this is the creepiness of an empty school
building huh…
[#SK0Kyyaaaa]?!
Wh-what's wrong?
[#SK0J]-just now, the window was rattling!
It's a poltergeist!
P-pole ter geist?

It was the grudge of an evil spirit that made
it rattle.
It's just the wind, you know.

You have no imagination. That's completely
unacceptable as a member of our brigade!
I-it was the grudge of an evil spirit?

I can say with certainty that it's not. I'll
prove it to you once this summer camp ends.
O-okayyy…
She looks utterly terrified.

Meanwhile, Haruhi has the nerve to cheerfully
enjoy her little paranormal search.
Looks like I should do something about this.
Hey, Haruhi…

If you scare Asahina too much it'll get in the
way of the investigation.

I know, but having a scaredy-cat with me
makes me want to rise to their expectations.

I don't think anyone's expecting anything of
you…

What about you. Isn't there anything you're
afraid of?

Me? Of course there isn't—I'm the SOS
Brigade Chief, you know?
Is there really nothing? You're certain?
There's nothing. I can assure you of that.

…Well, I suppose even when you saw that
enormous "Celestial,” you were relatively calm.

When Koizumi showed me, it kinda spooked me a
little…

Asahina, you don't need to be afraid, so feel
free to relax.

I'm here, and Nagato and Koizumi are here at
school too.

With those two around, there's no need to be
worried about most things. It'll be okay.

Th-that's right—Nagato is also here, after
all.

As expected it seems that Nagato is the most
reliable of the group.
I guess it can't be helped.
Mikuru! Behind you!
Eeeeeeeep?!
I lied, sorry!

Y-y-y-you just tried to scare me again,
right?
—?! Mikuru watch your step!
[#SK0Eeeeeeeeeeeek]?!

Juuust kidding! It's honestly just because
you're so cute, Mikuru.
[#SK0P]-pleeeease stop it!

After all that to calm her down, she's gone
right back to how she was.
Good grief…

Hmm, it doesn't seem like any of the library
books have a lead about class 1-10.

It doesn't seem like spirits or any of those
kinds of phenomena will show up either.
Sorry bout that, Haru-nyan.

You didn't do anything wrong. It's the un-
natural phenomena's fault for not showing up.

Right, let's keep exploring a bit longer. It's
started to get a little fun.
I'm getting sick of it.

It would at least be good to let Asahina
return to the clubroom.
Asahina…
[#SK0Hyaaaa]?!

She's like this just from me calling out to her a
little. She's absolutely terrified.
You have my sympathy, Asahina…

Maybe we should head for the art room next!
That place is very suspicious!
Hey, give us a break… No seriously.
Reassure her
Scare her a little
Calm Haruhi
Comfort Mikuru
